newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania T-bill issue heavily oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Romania T-bill issue heavily oversubscribed.

text.p: An issue of 659.03 billion lei in Romanian three-month treasury bills was oversubscribed this week, with bids by 12 banks outpacing by 353.71 billion lei the finance ministry's offer, the central bank said on Friday.
The T-bills, placed through a Dutch-style auction on Tuesday, offer an annual yield of 90 percent. The Banks' bids were between 70 and 115 percent.

More than 99 percent of the T-bills issue were bought by local commercial banks, branches and subsidiaries of foreign banks which operates in Romania. The rest were acquired for banks' corporate clients.
In recent months, the finance ministry has had several issues of bills with high annual yields, which touched almost 300 percent for floating rate papers.

Operators said returns were slipping in line with a gradual relaxation in the central bank's (BNR) monetary policy, which pushed down short-term money market rates to around 90 percent this week, from almost 220 percent in March. ($=7,081 lei)
